runtimeIntegrityFindings.finding: Evidence-integrity hazard for this verification: the live DB runs with a 4.1 MB pending WAL. Copying only agentic-os.db produces a snapshot that is not the live state, and leaving a stale -wal/-shm beside a freshly copied .db lets SQLite replay foreign frames — an early attempt in this run read back 10 channels plus a human gate created at 19:34:30Z (a previous run's write) and would have reported a seeded registry as the pre-seed state. Only the db + -wal + -shm co-copy reproduced the live state exactly (0 channels).
